messages:
kara: Quick sync 1: field asks keep coming for a 'no-rebind' upgrade lane that guarantees customer CIDRs and peering IPs survive upgrades. Need a terse decision + owners.

eli: We should make it opt-in: default fast lane unchanged, opt-in "guardian" lane that persists allocations and runs a migration.

priya: Implementation callouts: persist network allocation metadata to a PV or external KV (Vault/Consul) with no TTL, add installer flag `--guardian-network`, and a migration job that re-applies peer IPs and certs after control-plane replacement. Preflight must fail on CIDR overlap.

mike: UX: console toggle "Preserve customer network (guardian mode)" + explainer. Telemetry opt-in for post-upgrade verification (privacy-safe). Example preflight: `redwoodctl preflight --check-reserved 10.98.7.0/24`.

kara: Launch criteria draft: (1) installer supports reserved_cidrs + `--guardian-network`; (2) preflight checks and clear remediation; (3) migration job + `--retain-network-state`; (4) runbook/rollback steps; (5) two pilot validations.

eli: SLA note: guardian lane may need an operator window (~15-30m). Keep default SLOs unchanged. Add audit events `network.reserve` and `network.release` and require operator confirmation to release.

priya: Action owners: priya -> PR for persistence + migration (due Fri). mike -> UI copy + telemetry snippet (due Tue). kara -> consolidate launch criteria + schedule pilots (due Wed).

ops-bot: Pilot slot booked: 2026-11-10 11:00 UTC. Invite sent to kara, eli, priya, mike.

kara: Cool, we'll run pilot then decide whether to gate Private GA on guardian lane success. Thanks :thumbsup:"
